item.title: 3rd report, 2 previos ignored , danger to pedestrians@, women and girls, 16th August
item.description:
Public safety compromised as trees undergrowth have not been trimmed to date. This is the third(3rd) report of same issue. Please look at the report on 11th July and 9th August. Nothing has been done, not even a note that any action is being taken. Only reference numbers but you can retrieve this. The issue of of public safety. The undergrowth has overtaken a pavement on all sides@ It forces people too walk close to the busy road. Other issue is that it completely obstructs the view and provides hiding place for potential unwanted activity especially towards women and girls. This is just next to a bus stop, an Ally way( Sister Mabel's Way and a busy junction. Not sure why 2 previous reports were ignored and no action was taken. I noticed that similar issue was resolved elsewhere in the Borough so I am asking to take action immediately now. There is a vehicle of some sort dumped in there, which can cause tripping hazard in addition to all above. I will be escalating this further if no action taken as safety of the public should be taken seriously all over Southwark. Regards

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sister Mabel's Way, Peckham, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
